hero.tagline: A developer who loves building fun things.
hero.body: From servers and smart homes to AI, web services, hardware and games, here's what I've been making.
hero.bannerAlt: A silver-haired character wearing a witch hat

homelab.label: Homelab·Infra
homelab.title: A tiny datacenter at home
homelab.body: I run a Kubernetes cluster on mini PCs and a GPU workstation. The services I build and everyday ones like photo backups and a social network all run on it.

smarthome.label: Smart Home
smarthome.title: Running my home with code
smarthome.body: Every device in my home is connected and managed through Home Assistant. When a device or service has no official integration, I write one myself.

mlai.label: ML·AI
mlai.title: From models to services
mlai.body: I refine models myself, like speech synthesis and manga translation, and turn them into services I actually use. These days I also spend a lot of time working alongside AI agents.

web.label: Web Services
web.title: One login for everything
web.body: When I need a web service, I build it myself. It's a hobby server, but it supports TOTP and Passkeys, and one login gets you into everything from a manga translator to a quote search.

hardware.label: Hardware
hardware.title: Things you can touch and move
hardware.body: I design the circuits and PCBs, make the cases with CAD and a 3D printer, and have built a wireless macropad and a weapon from a game.

game.label: Game Dev
game.title: Making my own game
game.body: I'm building a bullet-hell action roguelite in Godot. From the world and characters to the maps, I'm filling it in piece by piece.

projects.lemon-k8s-cluster: A K3S homelab cluster on a mini PC and a GPU workstation
projects.misskey: A microblogging social network instance I run myself
projects.kepco-powerplanner-ha-addon: An add-on that brings KEPCO PowerPlanner electricity usage into Home Assistant
projects.hass-kakao-map-changer: An integration that swaps the Home Assistant map for Kakao Map
projects.lemon-tts: A Home Assistant integration that speaks Japanese from any input language
projects.hayakoe: A Japanese TTS library polished to be easy to use
projects.lemon-manga-translator: A pipeline that finds text in Japanese manga, translates it into Korean and redraws it
projects.claude-dashboard: A web dashboard that shows Claude Code usage at a glance
projects.geardrak: A 16-key wireless macropad I built myself, from circuit to case
projects.supernova: A 3D-printed display prop of Aris's Supernova from Blue Archive

contact.body: You can find more about my projects and the tools I use on my blog.
